subject: Helix Retail — Critical throughput & error spike — Executive coordination
messages:
From: Ibrahim Khan <ibrahim@helixretail.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.example>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.example>
Cc: Natalie Reed <natalie.reed@helixretail.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Spike in error rate / throughput collapse — urgent

Team,

We started seeing a large spike in 5xx errors and a sharp throughput drop across our checkout flows at ~07:45 PST. Error rate climbed to ~18% and API latency for some endpoints is >5s. This is causing payment failures for ~7% of active users in the last 30m.

We are paused on new campaigns and our ops team is receiving escalations from merchants. Please advise immediate remediation and ETA. We need an executive update to our CTO and merchant ops.

Attached: metrics_slice_11-30.csv (sample), brief logs included.

— Ibrahim
Head of Platform Engineering
Helix Retail
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.example>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.example>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.example>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.example>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.example>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.example>
Cc: Ibrahim Khan <ibrahim@helixretail.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Spike in error rate / throughput collapse — urgent

Folks — FYI. Ibrahim just opened this to our mailbox. This looks like both a latency and 5xx problem affecting Helix checkout. I started a debug run and collected heap dump and traces; attaching interim heap_dump_20261130.log.

Immediate asks:
- Can infra confirm whether this is traffic-pattern-induced (batch bot) vs. a regression tied to last-night’s routing change?
- SRE: can we temporarily scale dedicated pools for HLX (they're on Dedicated plan) and enable fallback routing to the lower-capacity variant?
- Eng: identify any deploys to model-serving or routing layer after 00:00 UTC.

I'll stand up a quick bridge in 10m. Sean, can you pull in execs for a readout?

— Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.example>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.example>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.example>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.example>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.example>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.example>, Ibrahim Khan <ibrahim@helixretail.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:28:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Spike in error rate / throughput collapse — urgent

Thanks Monica. Launching bridge now: https://zoom.redwood.com/rooms/helix-escalation-1130

Laura / Marissa — please join immediately for exec-level comms and customer cadence. David / Karthik / Kimberly — prioritize root-cause triage.

Initial plan (10:28):
- Short-term (0–30m): scale HLX dedicated pool + enable fallback routing to quantized-variant-2; throttle non-critical batched traffic.
- Mid-term (30–180m): confirm root cause, stabilize KV cache, and push hotfix if a regression.
- Customer comms: 15min cadence updates; first external update by 08:45 PST.

Ibrahim — we will join the bridge and provide the first public-facing note at 08:45. Laura, please prepare a short summary for Helix execs.

— Sean
VP, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.example>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.example>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.example>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.example>, Ibrahim Khan <ibrahim@helixretail.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:41:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Spike in error rate / throughput collapse — urgent

On the bridge. Early telemetry: we have a sudden spike in KV cache misses for the HLX routes starting 07:44 PST, concurrent with an increase in average sequence length for requests (likely due to a new campaign sending longer prompts). Cache pressure + longer sequences -> tokenization/alloc pressure and unhappy kernels.

Taking actions:
- Triggering temporary autoscale by +40% on Dedicated pool for HLX.
- Flushing cold KV cache for affected shards (non-disruptive) to relieve memory pressure.
- Rolling routing to quantized-variant-2 for any requests that don't require 16-bit outputs (should cut CPU by ~30%).

Asks: ops to confirm that scaling is honored by the scheduler; CS to notify customer of temporary degraded profile (lower fidelity fallback for a subset).

— Karthik
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.example>
To: Ibrahim Khan <ibrahim@helixretail.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.example>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.example>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.example>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.example>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Helix status — initial customer-facing update

Ibrahim — quick update from the bridge: we’ve identified a root cause pattern tied to an unexpected increase in request size and KV cache pressure; we have enacted temporary mitigations (scaling, cache flush, and fallback routing).

What to expect in the next 30m:
- Error rate should decline as fallback routing and scale activities complete.
- Throughput will be restored in batches; some requests may see a lower-quality fallback model for the short term.

We will provide a follow-up at 09:00 PST with telemetry and next steps. We understand the merchant impact and are prioritizing this end-to-end.

— Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.example>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.example>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.example>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.example>, Ibrahim Khan <ibrahim@helixretail.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Helix status — initial customer-facing update

Update from ops: scaling succeeded at 08:55 PST, error rate dropped to 4.2% at 09:00 PST, throughput recovered ~70% of baseline. We’re continuing to monitor.

Attached playbook and notes: sla_incident_playbook_v2.pdf — includes rollback criteria and communication templates.

Next actions:
- 09:30 PST: post-incident telemetry snapshot and proposed long-term fixes (cache configuration, autoscale policy tweak, model routing guardrails).
- 12:00 PST: exec readout with Helix CTO if they want deeper technical detail.

— Marissa
Director, Incident Response
From: Ibrahim Khan <ibrahim@helixretail.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.example>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.example>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.example>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.example>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.example>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.example>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Helix status — initial customer-facing update

Thanks all — appreciate the quick response. Error rate has returned to normal and merchants report stable payments. Our CTO wants a short post-mortem and a preventative plan for the caching/route-guard scenario; can you prepare a 1-page incident summary and proposed remediation by EOD today? Also please include an ask for capacity bumping thresholds in our Dedicated contract if autoscale costs exceed $X/day (we'll follow procurement).

We can make ourselves available for a 12:00 PST readout today if that helps.

— Ibrahim Khan
Head of Platform Engineering, Helix Retail
